arguments.command:
B=$(git rev-parse origin/main)
git worktree add -q /tmp/cl-wt HEAD && (cd /tmp/cl-wt && git commit -q --allow-empty --no-verify -m "release: v0.35.1") 
npx --no -- commitlint --cwd /tmp/cl-wt -g "$PWD/commitlint.config.js" --from "$B" --to "$(git -C /tmp/cl-wt rev-parse HEAD)" 2>&1 | grep -E "input|✖|found"; echo "bad-commit exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
git worktree remove --force /tmp/cl-wt; git branch -a | head; npm run lint:actions 2>&1 | tail -2
